Implementation of the wizard screens, lib/newproj/newproj_screens.sh and lib/newproj/newproj_screens/screen_*.sh; it [[fb-lib-newproj-screens|serves|These screen files are the concrete files the screens bead names.]]. They are the acfs screens verbatim, plus these macacfs changes. get_default_projects_dir and get_default_directory delegate to the shared ru-layout resolver. The directory screen accepts a missing ru layout folder beneath the projects base, with a warning. The features screen adds GitHub repo, make it public and register with ru checkboxes, which the state seeds from flags or settings (enable_github, enable_github_public, enable_ru). The progress screen runs newproj_remote_preflight before creating anything, creates layout folders first, and, with GitHub, replaces create_dir by a first clone_github step (newproj_remote_clone, a fresh-clone check, and project_dir, CREATION_PROJECT_DIR and WIZARD_PROJECT_ROOT moved to ru's path), then adds the publish_github step (commit and push; the only wizard step that commits, and it says so) and the register_ru step (a no-op once registered), mapping the checkboxes through newproj_wizard_remote_selection. The success screen suggests 'macacfs install' instead of acfs doctor and shows Antigravity (agy) only when it is installed; ntm, tmux and agy are each offered only when present. These screens [[fb-lib-newproj-remote-impl|calls|The progress and directory screens call newproj_remote_preflight, newproj_remote_publish, newproj_remote_ru and the layout helpers.]].
